description: TideFlow 1.0.2 - Fixed In-App APK Updater Permissions, Consolidated FileProvider & Smooth Install Flow

changelog.title: In-App Updater & APK Installation
items: Added REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission to AndroidManifest.xml, resolving in-app update installation failure on Android 8.0+.
Consolidated FileProvider authorities and paths, ensuring seamless URI resolution for downloaded update packages.
Added external-files-path and files-path support in provider_paths.xml.
Streamlined install flow with automatic installation launch as soon as 'Install unknown apps' permission is enabled.

changelog.title: AI Assistant & Playlist Engine
items: Full AI playlist queueing with continuous YouTube Radio auto-continuation.
Guaranteed track novelty and intelligent non-repetition memory.
Dedicated persistent storage for AI agent memories and session history.
Powered by ultra-fast NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B.

changelog.title: Core Improvements
items: Strict version check logic preventing spurious update notifications.
